exposure: Patients with no FHT abnormalities vs. patients with other FHT abnormalities in the first hour after misoprostol administration
outcome: Incidence of other FHT abnormalities (bradycardia, late or prolonged decelerations, absent or minimal variability)
cohort: 9908 low-risk patients at ≥37 weeks gestation who received oral misoprostol for cervical ripening prior to rupture of membranes
finding: The risk of short-term adverse outcomes associated with misoprostol is low among relatively low-risk patients, but FHT abnormalities occurred in up to 32% of patients in the first four hours of monitoring.
